title: 第14章 安排任务，截胡原圣灵教人才和医仙斗罗，布局开始
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“噗通！”

“张鹏愿誓死追随天使神大人！当赴汤蹈火，万死不辞！”

激动的声音和颤动的身体，千仞雪不用怀疑此刻张鹏的忠诚了，那么——

也就能放心让他去做接下来交代的事情了。

“张鹏，起来吧！”

“是，天使神大人！”

张鹏闻言起身，眼神中还残留着火热。

更别说千仞雪在他身上留下的天使印记，既是救赎也是约束。

想到这，千仞雪将自己这些天所想的布局理了理。

“张鹏，既然你已经是我天使殿一员，那本殿主有事需要你去做。”

“天使神大人请尽管吩咐，属下一定万死不辞！”

“好了，我的身份目前还是一个秘密，所以对外还需保密，日后还是唤我殿主吧。”

“是，殿主。”

“嗯，我要你做的事情很简单，如今我天使殿人才急缺，眼下最主要的是，笼络人才，发展天使殿。所以，张鹏，你首要的任务就是这个。

如今我殿有你我两位封号斗罗，虽可以傲视不少势力，但还不够，我们的敌人很强大，因此不论是高端战力还是低端战力都需要。而为了这个目的，张鹏，我这里有两个首要人选，一个备用人选。你去拉拢接触，务必将人招入我们天使殿。”

“是，殿主。不知您说的三位是？”

“两位首选为王仙儿，乌云，备选雷景幽。”

“竟是他们？”

“你认识？”

千仞雪看向惊呼的张鹏，有些诧异。

张鹏闻言点了点头：“确实有过几面之缘。王仙儿我有信心，她的武魂是治愈天使，您在此，我有很大把握邀她加入天使殿。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Plop!"

"Zhang Peng is willing to follow the Lord Angel God to the death! He will go through fire and water, even to the death!"

With her excited voice and trembling body, Qian Renxue no longer had to doubt Zhang Peng's loyalty at this moment, then——

You can then rest assured and let him do what he will be told next.

"Zhang Peng, get up!"

"Yes, Lord Angel God!"

Zhang Peng stood up after hearing the words, with fire still in his eyes.

Not to mention the angelic mark Qian Renxue left on him, which was both salvation and restraint.

Thinking of this, Qian Renxue sorted out what she had been thinking about these days.

"Zhang Peng, since you are already a member of my Angel Palace, the master of this palace needs you to do something."

"Lord Angel God, please do as you please, my subordinates will definitely die without mercy!"

"Well, my identity is still a secret for now, so it needs to be kept secret from the outside world. You should call me the Lord of the Palace in the future."

"Yes, Palace Master."

"Well, what I want you to do is very simple. Now our Angel Palace is in urgent need of talents. The most important thing right now is to recruit talents and develop the Angel Palace. So, Zhang Peng, your first priority is this.

Now that we have two Titled Douluo, you and I, we can dominate many forces, but it is not enough. Our enemies are very powerful, so we need both high-end combat power and low-end combat power.And for this purpose, Zhang Peng, I have two primary candidates and one backup candidate.If you go to make contact, you must recruit people into our Angel Temple."

"Yes, Palace Master. Who are the three you are talking about?"

"The two first choices are Wang Xian'er, Wu Yun, and the second choice is Lei Jingyou."

"It's them?"

"You know him?"

Qian Renxue looked at Zhang Peng who exclaimed, somewhat surprised.

Zhang Peng nodded when he heard this: "We have indeed met several times. I am confident that Wang Xian'er's martial spirit is a healing angel. With you here, I am very confident to invite her to join the Angel Hall."
